typeSystemExample.caption: Generic max: dynamic typing, no annotations
typeSystemExample.source:
function max_of(a, b)
  if a >= b then return a else return b end
end

print(max_of(3, 7))
print(max_of(1.5, 2.8))

runtime: Register-based bytecode VM; modern PUC-Lua versions provide incremental and generational garbage-collection modes

runtimes.name: LuaJIT
runtimes.role: Lua 5.1-compatible implementation with a tracing JIT compiler.

concurrencyExample.caption: 4 workers computing i*i via cooperative coroutines
concurrencyExample.source:
local results = {}

for i = 0, 3 do
  local co = coroutine.create(function(n)
    coroutine.yield(n * n)
  end)
  local _, val = coroutine.resume(co, i)
  results[#results + 1] = val
end

print(table.concat(results, " "))
